# Rails: two steel bars (0.06 x 0.08 m, gauge 0.46) swept along the main loop and the four B lanes
# (extrude for straights, spin for arcs), bottoms deleted (they stand on the floor). Generated by
# make_env.py from the same layout as scene/game.as's track table.
new
material new Rail --base-color 0.259 0.431 0.365 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name MainL --size 1 --location -2.5900 1.9300 0.040
scale 0.02 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
active MainL
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.9"
extrude 5.2000 0.0000 0
spin --steps 24 --angle -180 --axis z --center 2.6000 0.0000 0
extrude -5.2000 -0.0000 0
spin --steps 24 --angle -180 --axis z --center -2.6000 -0.0000 0
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
material assign Rail
add mesh cube --name MainR --size 1 --location -2.5900 1.4700 0.040
scale 0.02 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
active MainR
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.9"
extrude 5.2000 0.0000 0
spin --steps 24 --angle -180 --axis z --center 2.6000 0.0000 0
extrude -5.2000 -0.0000 0
spin --steps 24 --angle -180 --axis z --center -2.6000 -0.0000 0
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
material assign Rail
add mesh cube --name Lane0L --size 1 --location -1.9488 1.9300 0.040
scale 0.02 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
active Lane0L
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.9"
spin --steps 8 --angle 60 --axis z --center -1.9588 2.6000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle -60 --axis z --center -0.4000 1.7000 0
extrude 0.8000 0.0000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle -60 --axis z --center 0.4000 1.7000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle 60 --axis z --center 1.9588 2.6000 0
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
material assign Rail
add mesh cube --name Lane0R --size 1 --location -1.9488 1.4700 0.040
scale 0.02 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
active Lane0R
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.9"
spin --steps 8 --angle 60 --axis z --center -1.9588 2.6000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle -60 --axis z --center -0.4000 1.7000 0
extrude 0.8000 0.0000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle -60 --axis z --center 0.4000 1.7000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle 60 --axis z --center 1.9588 2.6000 0
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
material assign Rail
add mesh cube --name Lane1L --size 1 --location 2.6100 1.9300 0.040
scale 0.02 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
active Lane1L
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.9"
spin --steps 12 --angle -90 --axis z --center 2.6000 0.9000 0
extrude 0.0000 -1.8000 0
spin --steps 12 --angle -90 --axis z --center 2.6000 -0.9000 0
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
material assign Rail
add mesh cube --name Lane1R --size 1 --location 2.6100 1.4700 0.040
scale 0.02 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
active Lane1R
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.9"
spin --steps 12 --angle -90 --axis z --center 2.6000 0.9000 0
extrude 0.0000 -1.8000 0
spin --steps 12 --angle -90 --axis z --center 2.6000 -0.9000 0
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
material assign Rail

scale 0.02 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
active Lane2L
mode edit
select face where "normal.x < -0.9"
spin --steps 8 --angle 60 --axis z --center 1.9588 -2.6000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle -60 --axis z --center 0.4000 -1.7000 0
extrude -0.8000 -0.0000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle -60 --axis z --center -0.4000 -1.7000 0

extrude -0.8000 -0.0000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle -60 --axis z --center -0.4000 -1.7000 0
spin --steps 8 --angle 60 --axis z --center -1.9588 -2.6000 0
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"

material assign Rail

spin --steps 12 --angle -90 --axis z --center -2.6000 0.9000 0
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
material assign Rail
select MainL MainR Lane0L Lane0R Lane1L Lane1R Lane2L Lane2R Lane3L Lane3R
active MainL
join
rename MainL Rails
shade flat
export rails.glb
